title: Ordinary check recognition rejects the launcher's valid --input commit spelling, so its test runs never attach the observed-command artifact
outcome: Recognize the launcher's valid committed-input focused command without changing its request/argv identity or weakening artifact and association guards.
acceptance: A valid foreground `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit -- cargo test` is recognized as a Test, and a matching real registered run locator attaches only to its exact observed command; cover the corresponding focused Build classification without reclassifying build-only work as Test.

Negative coverage refuses unsupported --input values, missing values, duplicate or malformed input options, unsupported launcher flags, non-test inner commands and compile-only/no-run inner commands as passing Test evidence; mismatched runtime/tool/owner/request/artifact associations remain refused.

Preserve the actual observed argv and request/input metadata, canonical artifact validation, publication/durability and evidence association checks. Never strip --input while retaining commit-input artifacts, fabricate an observed row, bypass guards or restore per-turn gating.
